reason: Tokens and theming follow-ups (spec 001), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 027-catalog-required-props (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). No published name is added, renamed or removed: the delta is entirely effective-value changes to already-published leaves, confined to the material3 dark context of the ./css/material3 stylesheet. material3's dark mode file defined the danger and success tone families and neither info nor warning, and material3DarkConfig does not include the onmars dark file, so both families kept their LIGHT values on the material3 dark page (declaration a11y-contrast-floor already recorded the symptom: the ki-status warning mark at 3.33:1 'where the theme does not flip the warning ramp'). The theme now decides them, with the steps its own dark success family uses: --ki-surface-{info,warning}-high-em and -med-em move to step 300, -low-em to 800, -base-em to 950; --ki-text-{info,warning}-high-em to 300, -med-em to 400, -low-em to 500, -base-em to 700. Sixteen semantic leaves, and the six component leaves that alias them: --ki-badge-info-bg #d0f1fb to #032630 and --ki-badge-info-fg #085268 to #71d5f4 (text 7.30:1 to 9.46:1; the chip against the #141218 page 15.63:1 to 1.17:1); --ki-badge-warning-bg #fffeea to #321f01 and --ki-badge-warning-fg #945b05 to #fbcb84 (text 5.49:1 to 10.49:1; chip against the page 18.25:1 to 1.18:1); --ki-status-info-color #0f94bd to #71d5f4 (5.30:1 to 11.09:1 against the page) and --ki-status-warning-color #945b05 to #fbcb84 (3.33:1 to 12.38:1). The info and warning badges were light chips beside dark neutral, success and danger ones; they are now dark containers with tone ink, as their siblings. This is a deliberate visual change to ki-badge and ki-status under material3 dark and to nothing else: material3 light and both onmars schemes resolve every token to the value they had, and the translucent -low-em-alpha and -base-em-alpha tints are untouched (they take the scheme of whatever they are painted over). The outline tone families are not addressed: material3 dark defines none for success, info or warning, and they feed button and icon-button borders. The contrast gate gains two derived sweeps so the gap cannot return unnoticed: every --ki-text-<tone>-high-em ink is held to 4.5:1 against the page (WCAG 1.4.3), and the tones of one component cell must share a polarity within a scheme. Unrelated to the surface digest: the default color-scheme declaration of ./css is now emitted at zero specificity (:where(:root)) so a host page's own color-scheme wins (spec 001 S14); token names and values are unchanged by it. No committed screenshot changes: the visual harness captures material3 in the light scheme only. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
